scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:node && pnpm run typecheck:web
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && electron-vite build && electron-builder
scripts.build:mac: pnpm run typecheck && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac
scripts.build:win: pnpm run typecheck && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win
scripts.build:linux: pnpm run typecheck && electron-vite build && electron-builder --linux
scripts.release: pnpm run typecheck && electron-vite build && electron-builder --publish always
scripts.release:mac: pnpm run typecheck && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac --publish always
scripts.release:win: pnpm run typecheck && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win --publish always
scripts.release:linux: pnpm run typecheck && electron-vite build && electron-builder --linux --publish always
